title: P0.71: Live UI Presence Contract + UIBridge Truthfulness + Human-Simulated Chat Audit
description: Codex Windows audit revealed: UIBridge reported ui_running=true but send_message went to buffer without ControlCenterViewModel; navigate('control') reported success but route didn't change; startup_bridge_reused was treated as sufficient even when no UI process existed; two python processes fought over port 18921; 'sigue' fell to local provider at 112s latency. P0.71 closes these gaps with truth contracts, presence verification, and causal freeze diagnosis.
root_cause: UIBridge lacked fail-closed semantics: it would return 'buffered' or 'navigated' even when no ControlCenterViewModel was bound. start_iabv.ps1 had no single-instance guard for the UI process. FreezeIncidentReporter didn't capture bridge/control VM state at stall time, so cause remained 'unknown'. OSES had no findings for bridge truth violations.
implemented_tasks: A. start_iabv.ps1: UI Presence Contract — startup_bridge_reused NOT sufficient when -StartUI; checks for existing UI process; emits traces (ui_presence_check_started/result, ui_launch_started/result/failed)

B. start_iabv.ps1: Single UI Instance Sovereignty — Find-ExistingUIProcess detects duplicate, Test-BridgePortOwner verifies port owner, emits ui_duplicate_prevented/ui_bridge_port_conflict/ui_bridge_owner_verified

C. UIBridgeService: Truth Contract — send_message returns status=unavailable when no VM (not 'buffered'); get_ui_state exposes control_vm_bound, chat_ready, navigation_controller_bound, current_page_verified, PIDs; navigate verifies route actually changed (status=failed if not)
D. scripts/human_simulated_chat_audit.py: runner that connects to live bridge and tests reachability, VM binding, navigation, metacognitive phrases, response latency, shell readiness
E. FreezeIncidentReporter: _capture_ui_bridge_state() probes bridge for control_vm_bound, chat_ready, PIDs at freeze time; included in every incident report
F. OSES: _ui_bridge_truth_findings() detects bridge_claimed_ready_but_no_vm, local_chat_slow_after_continuity, ui_stall_without_causal_phase, duplicate_ui_bridge_owner — observe/recommend only
not_duplicated: No new cerebro or orchestrator created
UIBridgeStatus extended (not replaced) with truth contract fields
FreezeIncidentReporter extended (not replaced) with bridge state capture
OSES findings added via the same pattern as P0.69 (external impl function attached to class)
ControlCenterViewModel NOT modified — it already handles metacognitive phrases from P0.69
